basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and nature enthusiast residing in the Pacific Northwest. I work as a software developer during the day and spend my evenings exploring the vast worlds of Monster Hunter and other compelling video games. I'm particularly fascinated by wildlife, especially lynxes, and often participate in conservation projects. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to game late into the night. I typically log into Reddit in the evenings and weekends. I'm also exploring ways to manage my trichotillomania, sharing tips and experiences with others who face similar challenges.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a passion for video games, I've honed my skills through both formal education and countless hours of self-teaching. My expertise in software development is complemented by a deep understanding of gaming mechanics and wildlife conservation, gathered through years of personal interest and volunteering.
